about.title: Who we are?
about.description: At MABASA, we specialize in providing comprehensive solutions in automation, design, machining, welding, and engineering projects. Our commitment is to deliver high-quality services that meet the specific needs of our clients in various industrial sectors.

hero.description: Test cells, control and SCADA, conveyors and purpose-built devices. Engineered, manufactured and installed by our own engineers — no middlemen between the plant problem and the people who solve it.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: We offer innovative solutions tailored to the needs and budget of our clients, with personalized and timely attention.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: We aim to be the best alternative for companies to integrate into the future through our solutions, always distinguished by the quality and professionalism in each of our services.

qualityPolicy.title: Quality Policy
qualityPolicy.description: Deliver a quality service by meeting customer requirements and offering innovative solutions. Develop our engineers through specialized training, leadership, and commitment.

googleMap.heroDescription: Describe it in one email — process, cycle time and the downtime you can take. You get scope and an estimate back, not a catalogue.
googleMap.address: Correo Mayor #1493-3. Postal Cerritos Neighborhood, Saltillo, Coahuila, Mexico

ourClients.title: Our Clients
ourClients.description: Plants across northern Mexico currently running equipment designed, built and installed by MABASA.

service1.title: AUTOMATED HYDRAULIC STATIONS
service1.description: Designed and built to the production requirement: force and stroke control, cycle logging, out-of-tolerance lockout.

service2.title: CONVEYORS
service2.description: Roller and belt conveyors, modular and reconfigurable to the plant layout, with zero-pressure accumulation zones.

service3.title: PNEUMATIC STATIONS, DESIGN AND MANUFACTURING.
service3.item1: Substrate and vinyl alignment stations for automotive parts
service3.description: Substrate and vinyl alignment for automotive parts, with orientation poka-yoke and a step-guided cycle.

service4.title: CRANES AND LIFTING EQUIPMENT
service4.item1: Design and development of lifting equipment from user products.
service4.description: Lifting equipment developed from the actual product and the ergonomics of the operator who will handle it.

service5.title: RACKS AND MIC WELDING
service5.item2: Manufacturing of supports, structures, and special design parts.
service5.description: Racks, shelving, brackets and special-design structures. MIG welding with a written procedure and material traceability.

service6.title: MACHINING
service6.description: Industrial components and precision fixtures, with documented improvements over the design already on the floor.

service7.title: ANDON SYSTEM
service7.item1: Multidisciplinary projects to meet customer needs.
service7.description: Line signalling and visual control: every station's state visible from the aisle, with downtime logging.

service8.title: DESIGN
service8.description: CAD, CAM and CAE. Mechanical, electrical and software design validated on screen before any steel is cut.

service9.title: EXTRACTION CABIN
service9.item1: Design and manufacturing of cabins according to customer needs.
service9.description: Booths and workbenches built to the process requirement, the extraction needed and the operator's reach.

service10.title: HIGH-QUALITY 3D PRINTING
service10.item1: High-quality 3D printing that guarantees precise, detailed parts.
service10.item2: Faithful to the digital design, ideal for prototypes and industrial production.
service10.description: Accurate parts, faithful to the digital model — for rapid prototyping and low-volume industrial production.
